file_subset_policy: Roman-general 1960/1962 build-out subset -- the Latin content this lane's minimum shippable floor (architecture doc §10) needs: full Tempora/Sancti/Commune/Psalterium/Appendix, plus the 1960-rubric Martyrologium. Deliberately excludes monastic/Dominican/Cistercian variant directories (TemporaM/SanctiM/CommuneM, TemporaCist/SanctiCist/CommuneCist, TemporaOP/SanctiOP/CommuneOP), the pre-1955/1960 Martyrologium editions (Martyrologium1570, Martyrologium1955R), Regula (Benedictine Rule readings, monastic-only), and Necrologium -- all out of scope per architecture §11's 'no monastic or Dominican variants.'
mirrored_files_note: Prayers.txt and Rubricae.txt added 2026-09-27, full-audit pass. Invitatorium.txt/Doxologies.txt/Benedictions.txt/Mariaant.txt added 2026-09-27 continued (full build-out pass) as part of completing the Psalterium common-texts mirror alongside the directory-level entries below. Extracted via `git archive <pinned commit>`, same integrity basis as mirrored_directories below.
mirrored_directories_note: Psalmorum (Latin+English) added 2026-09-27 -- the full 150-psalm Vulgate Psalter (202 files incl. Ps.118's subdivided sections) and its parallel English translation, already in the Breviary's own native numbering. Special/Psalmi/Tempora/Sancti/Commune/Martyrologium1960/Appendix added 2026-09-27 continued (full build-out pass, architecture §10's minimum shippable floor: all 8 hours x the Roman general calendar x current+next year) -- the remaining Latin content the oracle-based build pipeline's calendar computation and per-hour common texts depend on. English Tempora/Sancti/Commune/Martyrologium added 2026-09-27, later still (English-lane reconnaissance-into-build-out) -- mirrors the same subset of content Latin's own Tempora/Sancti/Commune/Martyrologium1960 mirror serves, so a future audit has the same in-repo provenance for English it already has for Latin. Two disclosed gaps, not oversights: upstream has no English 'Appendix' directory at all (Latin's has 9 files; no English counterpart exists at this pinned commit), and upstream's English martyrology has only base 'Martyrologium' (369 files, matching Latin's own base Martyrologium 1:1), not the rubric-year-specific 'Martyrologium1960' Latin also mirrors -- the English build pipeline does not currently read the martyrology at all, so this is disclosed for completeness, not a build blocker. All extracted via `git archive <pinned commit>` from an authenticated fetch of this exact commit SHA (not a raw-HTTP scrape), so content integrity is already covered by git's own object hashing; see AUDIT_GOVERNANCE_LEDGER.md's 2026-09-27 entries for how these were obtained. The build pipeline's actual oracle computation runs against a separate full clone checked out to this same pinned commit (verified by `scripts/roman-breviary-oracle-run.mjs`'s own pin check at every invocation) -- this mirror exists for in-repo provenance/audit purposes per architecture §12 Layer A, not as the pipeline's live input.
engine_read_set_note: 2026-10-03 (Breviary component-engine phase 1): added everything the Divinum Perl engine opens for Rubrics 1960 that was not yet mirrored, found by strace-tracing officium.pl at this exact commit over 24 sample dates x 8 hours x Latin/English (559 distinct files; list in ../engine-read-set-2026-10-03.txt). Added: Tabulae (Kalendaria 15 files incl. NC.txt for the planned 2020 USA add-on, Tempora, data.txt, top-level Transfer and Stransfer tables; diocese subdirectories deliberately excluded), horas/Ordinarium (6 hour templates), the rest of Latin and English Psalterium, Latin/Martyrologium/Mobile.txt, horas.setup, horas.dialog. Extracted with git archive from this pinned commit; all 559 traced files are byte-identical to the pinned commit.
include_closure_note: 2026-10-03 (phase 2 reader test): the Roman data files include text from variant folders (SanctiM, TemporaM, CommuneM, *Cist, *OP) via '@folder/file:Section' lines; the engine reads those through setupstring(), so they are part of the Roman read set even though the variant offices are out of scope. Added the transitive include closure (67 files, listed in ../include-closure-2026-10-03.txt) from this pinned commit; byte-identical copies. No other variant files are mirrored.
